title: CollectionRequest
description: A request asking a mobile subscriber to send funds to you.

organization.description: ID of the organization that owns the request.

amount.description: The collection request amount. Decimal serialised as a string, e.g. "3000.0000".

currency.description: 3-letter currency code (BXC is the Beyonic test currency).

account.description: ID of the account the collection will be sent to.

phonenumber.description: Phone number the request is for, international format.

metadata.description: Custom key/value metadata (up to 10 string attributes).

collection.description: ID of the collection that fulfilled the request, if any.

success_message.description: Confirmation SMS sent on successful payment.

send_instructions.description: Whether payment instructions are sent to the subscriber (defaults to false).

instructions.description: Override for the default instructions; "skip" sends none.

status.description: pending, pending_dispatched, processing_started, successful, failed, expired or reversed (filters also accept instructions_sent).

author.description: ID of the user who created the object.

modified.description: When the object was last modified (UTC).

updated_by.description: ID of the user who last updated the object.
